nodes.label: Case P-HPU: HPU Pressure Handoff
nodes.rationale: V-11 persona distinguishes sensory observation from source estimation. Focuses on HPU-01 pressure (112 bar) and specific targets RT-02/RT-03.

nodes.label: Case P-GR: Gear/Drive Noise Handoff
nodes.rationale: V-11 persona reports abnormal sound near GR-02. Distinguishes between observation (sound) and unconfirmed damage (gears/bearings).

nodes.label: Case P-RT: Roller Table Material Flow Handoff
nodes.rationale: V-12 persona reports intermittent material stoppage at RT-02. Notes specific measurement tag rt_lift_delay.

nodes.label: Case P-CV: Conveyor Queue Handoff
nodes.rationale: V-12 persona reports queue percentages for CV-01 and CV-02. Explicitly avoids copying metrics between different equipment.
